titleEn: Hardwood vs. Luxury Vinyl Plank Flooring in Vancouver: A Homeowner's Guide 2026
titleZh: 温哥华实木地板与豪华乙烯基塑料地板对比：2026 业主指南
contentEn:
Vancouver homeowners renovating their floors in 2026 face a clear choice: traditional hardwood or luxury vinyl plank (LVP). Both look similar in a showroom, but their performance in Metro Vancouver's damp climate, installation requirements, and long-term cost differ significantly.

For most Vancouver renovations, luxury vinyl plank offers better value — waterproof construction, faster installation, and lower maintenance. Hardwood appeals to buyers and adds resale value but requires more upkeep in our rainy coastal environment.

Hardwood Flooring: What Vancouver Homeowners Pay in 2026

Solid hardwood flooring costs more upfront and requires professional installation. In Metro Vancouver, the installed cost of solid or engineered hardwood typically ranges from $12 to $25 per square foot, with exotic species running higher. A typical 1,000-square-foot condo or townhouse floor costs $12,000 to $25,000 fully installed.

Hardwood installed in Vancouver must be acclimatized for at least 48-72 hours before fitting — our humidity levels differ from warehouse conditions in Ontario or the US. Pre-finished engineered hardwood with a thick wear layer (3mm+) handles Vancouver humidity better than solid hardwood, which can cup or gap with seasonal moisture changes.

Refinishing solid hardwood restores its original appearance. Most Vancouver contractors charge $3-$6 per square foot to sand and refinish, and the process can be done 2-4 times over a floor's 40-80 year lifespan. Engineered hardwood with a thin wear layer cannot be refinished — only screened and recoated.

Luxury Vinyl Plank: Installed Cost and Performance in 2026

Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) has become the dominant choice for Vancouver condo and townhouse renovations. Waterproof construction — the core advantage over hardwood — prevents the swelling, cupping, and warping that plague wood floors during Vancouver's rainy season and occasional basement floods.

Installed LVP costs range from $8 to $15 per square foot depending on product quality and subfloor condition. Mid-range LVP ($10-$13/sq ft) with a 20-mil wear layer and attached underlayment suits most residential applications. Premium LVP ($14-$18/sq ft) with thicker wear layer (22-30 mil) better handles high-traffic areas and pet claws.

A 1,000-square-foot condo floor typically costs $8,000 to $18,000 fully installed including subfloor prep, underlayment, and baseboard reinstallation. Professional installation for LVP takes 1-3 days versus 5-7 days for hardwood.

Which Floor Type Suits Your Vancouver Home?

A condo flooring replacement in Richmond illustrates the choice clearly. A recent Reno Stars project replaced aging carpet with light oak engineered plank in a high-rise condo. The client chose engineered hardwood over solid hardwood for its dimensional stability in the building's controlled but seasonally variable humidity. Installation took six days including acclimatization and three coats of finish.

The same renovation with LVP would have cost approximately 40% less and completed in two days. Neither choice is wrong — it depends on your budget, timeline, and long-term plans for the home.

Basement suites present the clearest case for LVP. Below-grade installations with potential moisture from slab seepage or plumbing leaks make hardwood a liability. A single flood event can destroy $15,000-$25,000 of hardwood; LVP survives with drying.

Common Vancouver Flooring Mistakes to Avoid

The most common error Reno Stars sees in Vancouver flooring projects is installing hardwood over a concrete slab without proper moisture testing. BC Building Code requires a calcium chloride test or relative humidity probe reading before installing wood over concrete in below-grade applications. Results above 75% RH require a vapour barrier or dehumidification period before proceeding.

A second mistake is choosing an LVP product without a thick enough wear layer. A 6-8 mil wear layer suitable for light residential use will show scratches and wear tracks within 3-5 years in a busy household with children or pets. Always specify 20 mil or higher for family homes.

A third mistake is reusing existing baseboards with new floor heights. LVP and hardwood have different thickness profiles. Baseboards must be refitted or adjusted to the new floor height — this labour is always included in a professional installation quote.

Frequently Asked Questions: Flooring Vancouver 2026

Is luxury vinyl plank better than hardwood for Vancouver condos?

For most Vancouver condo and townhouse applications, LVP is the better value choice — lower cost, faster installation, and complete waterproofing. Hardwood is preferable if resale value is a primary concern or if the space is above grade with stable humidity control. A 2026 renovation with LVP in a typical 900-1,100 sq ft Metro Vancouver condo typically runs $9,000-$16,000 fully installed.

How much does new flooring cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Flooring replacement in Metro Vancouver costs $8-$15 per square foot installed for mid-range LVP, $12-$25 per square foot for quality hardwood. A full condo floor replacement (900-1,100 sq ft) typically runs $10,000-$20,000 depending on material choice. Hardwood floors in Vancouver typically take 5-7 days to install properly, including acclimatization time.

Can you install new flooring over existing flooring in Vancouver?

In many cases, yes — LVP can often install directly over a clean, flat, level existing floor. Hardwood typically requires removal of the existing floor. A professional contractor will assess subfloor flatness (maximum 3/16 inch deviation over 10 feet) before approving a covering approach.

2026 年温哥华的装修业主在地板选择上面临两个选项：传统实木地板或豪华乙烯基塑料地板（LVP）。在展厅里两者看起来相似，但在我们潮湿的沿海气候下的性能、安装要求以及长期成本方面差异显著。

对于大多数温哥华装修，豪华乙烯基塑料地板性价比更高——防水结构，更快的安装速度以及更低的维护成本。实木地板对买家有吸引力，能增加转售价值，但在多雨的沿海环境中需要更多保养。

实木地板：温哥华业主 2026 年的实际付费

实木地板的前期成本更高，需要专业安装。在大温地区，实木或工程实木地板的安装成本通常为每平方英尺 $12-$25，异域品种价格更高。典型的 1,000 平方英尺公寓或联排别墅地板完全安装的费用为 $12,000-$25,000。

在温哥华安装的实木地板必须在安装前适应环境至少 48-72 小时——我们的湿度水平与仓库条件不同。具有厚耐磨层（3mm+）的预制工程实木地板比实木地板更能适应温哥华的湿度变化。

翻新实木地板可以恢复其原始外观。大多数温哥华承包商的打磨翻新收费为每平方英尺 $3-$6，此过程在地板 40-80 年的使用寿命内可进行 2-4 次。

豪华乙烯基塑料地板：2026 年已安装成本及性能

豪华乙烯基塑料地板（LVP）已成为温哥华公寓和联排别墅装修的主流选择。防水结构——相对于实木的核心优势——防止在雨季和偶尔的洪水中发生的膨胀、杯形变形和翘曲。

安装 LVP 的成本根据产品质量和底层地面状况从每平方英尺 $8 到 $15 不等。具有 20-mil 耐磨层和附带隔声层的中级 LVP（每平方英尺 $10-$13）适合大多数住宅应用。

典型的 1,000 平方英尺公寓地板，包括底层地面准备、隔声层和踢脚板重新安装，通常花费 $8,000 到 $18,000。LVP 的专业安装需要 1-3 天，而实木需要 5-7 天。

并排对比：温哥华的实木地板与 LVP

因素实木地板豪华乙烯基塑料地板
安装成本（每平方英尺）$12-$25$8-$15
1,000 平方英尺总计$12,000-$25,000$8,000-$18,000
防水否——易受潮湿损坏是——100% 防水结构
温哥华湿度性能需要适应环境；可能有季节性缝隙稳定；无需留膨胀缝
安装时间5-7 天（包括面漆固化时间）1-3 天
可翻新是——2-4 次（仅实木）否——磨损时更换
使用寿命40-80 年（实木地板）15-25 年
转售价值影响积极——买家重视实木地板中性——质量差异很大
宠物抓挠抵抗力中等——宠物可能留下凹痕高——陶瓷珠耐磨层防抓挠

哪种地板类型适合您的温哥华住宅？

列治文公寓地板更换项目清楚地说明了这一选择。最近的 Reno Stars 项目用浅色橡木工程木板替换了高层公寓的陈旧地毯。客户选择了工程实木地板而非实木地板，因为其尺寸稳定性更好。安装包括适应期和三层面漆，共用了六天完成。

如果使用 LVP 进行同样的装修，成本将降低约 40%，工期仅需两天。两种选择都没有错——取决于您的预算、工期和对房屋的长期规划。

地下室套房是 LVP 最清晰的选择。一次洪水事件可能毁坏 $15,000-$25,000 的实木地板；而 LVP 只需晾干即可。

温哥华地板装修常见错误避免

最常见的错误是在未进行适当湿度测试的情况下，在混凝土板上安装实木地板。BC 建筑规范要求在进行地下混凝土上的木材安装前进行氯化钙测试或相对湿度探针读数。

第二个错误是选择耐磨层不够厚的 LVP 产品。有儿童或宠物的家庭请务必选择 20 mil 或更高规格。

第三个错误是在新地板高度下重复使用现有的踢脚板。专业安装报价中始终包含此人工调整。

常见问题：温哥华 2026 年地板装修

豪华乙烯基塑料地板比实木地板更适合温哥华公寓吗？

对于大多数温哥华公寓和联排别墅应用，LVP 是性价比更高的选择——成本更低、安装更快、完全防水。如果转售价值是主要考虑因素，实木地板是更好的选择。2026 年在典型 900-1,100 平方英尺的大温公寓进行 LVP 装修，通常花费 $9,000-$16,000 全包安装。

2026 年温哥华新地板装修多少钱？

大温地区地板更换的中级 LVP 安装成本为每平方英尺 $8-$15，优质实木为每平方英尺 $12-$25。完整公寓地板更换（900-1,100 平方英尺）根据材料选择通常花费 $10,000-$20,000。温哥华的实木地板通常需要 5-7 天才能正确安装，包括适应环境时间。

可以在温哥华现有地板上安装新地板吗？

在许多情况下可以——LVP 通常可以直接安装在清洁、平整、水平的现有地板上。实木地板通常需要拆除现有地板。
